```php
// packages/core/src/Database/Data/SchemaSet.php
/**
 * One package-owned directory of migrations that always runs together on one kind of database.
 */
#[Spi(kind: SpiKind::Call, since: '1.0')]
final readonly class SchemaSet
{
    /**
     * @param  list<string>  $drivers
     * @param  list<string>  $requires
     */
    public function __construct(
        public string $package,
        public string $name,
        public SchemaScope $scope,
        public string $path,
        public int $version,
        public array $drivers = ['pgsql'],
        public SchemaLifecycle $lifecycle = SchemaLifecycle::Platform,
        public array $requires = [],
        public ?string $connection = null,
    ) {
        if (preg_match('/^[a-z0-9-]+$/', $name) !== 1 || $version < 1 || ! in_array('pgsql', $drivers, true)
            || ($scope === SchemaScope::Dedicated) !== ($connection !== null)) {
            throw SchemaSetException::invalidSet($package.':'.$name);
        }
    }

    public function id(): string
    {
        return $this->package.':'.$this->name;
    }
}

// packages/core/src/Database/Data/SchemaSetStatus.php
#[Spi(kind: SpiKind::Call, since: '1.0')]

    /**
     * @param  list<string>  $applied
     * @param  list<string>  $pending
     */
    public function __construct(public SchemaSet $set, public array $applied, public array $pending) {}
}
```

## 3. Реестр и исполнитель

```php
// packages/core/src/Database/Internal/TaggedSchemaSets.php
/** @internal */
final class TaggedSchemaSets implements SchemaSets
{
    /** @var array<string, SchemaSet> */
    private readonly array $sets;

    /** @param iterable<SchemaSetProvider> $providers */
    public function __construct(iterable $providers)
    {
        $declared = [];
        foreach ($providers as $provider) {
            foreach ($provider->sets() as $set) {
                if (isset($declared[$set->id()])) {
                    throw SchemaSetException::duplicateSet($set->id());
                }
                if (! is_dir($set->path)) {
                    throw SchemaSetException::invalidSet($set->id());
                }
                $declared[$set->id()] = $set;
            }
        }

        $packages = array_unique(array_map(static fn (SchemaSet $s): string => $s->package, $declared));
        $active = array_filter($declared, static fn (SchemaSet $s): bool => array_diff($s->requires, $packages) === []);
        ksort($active, SORT_STRING);

        $seen = [];
        foreach ($active as $set) {
            foreach (glob($set->path.'/*_*.php') ?: [] as $file) {
                $key = $set->scope->value.'/'.basename($file, '.php');
                if (isset($seen[$key])) {
                    throw SchemaSetException::duplicateMigration(basename($file), $seen[$key], $set->id());
                }
                $seen[$key] = $set->id();
            }
        }

        $this->sets = $active;
    }

    public function all(): array
    {
        return array_values($this->sets);
    }

    public function forScope(SchemaScope $scope, bool $includeModules): array
    {
        return array_values(array_filter($this->sets, static fn (SchemaSet $s): bool => $s->scope === $scope
            && ($includeModules || $s->lifecycle === SchemaLifecycle::Platform)));
    }

    public function get(string $id): SchemaSet
    {
        return $this->sets[$id] ?? throw SchemaSetException::unknownSet($id);
    }

    public function moduleSet(string $package): ?SchemaSet
    {
        foreach ($this->sets as $set) {
            if ($set->package === $package && $set->lifecycle === SchemaLifecycle::Module && $set->scope === SchemaScope::Tenant) {
                return $set;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }
}

// packages/core/src/Database/Internal/LaravelSchemaMigrator.php
/** @internal */
final readonly class LaravelSchemaMigrator implements SchemaMigrator
{
    public function __construct(private SchemaSets $sets, private Migrator $migrator, private DatabaseManager $db) {}

    public function migrate(SchemaScope $scope, ?string $connection = null, bool $includeModules = false): array
    {
        $sets = $this->sets->forScope($scope, $includeModules);

        if ($scope === SchemaScope::Dedicated) {
            if ($connection !== null) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException('Dedicated schema sets run on their own connections.');
            }
            $ran = [];
            foreach ($sets as $set) {
                $ran = [...$ran, ...$this->run([$set], (string) $set->connection)];
            }

            return $ran;
        }

        return $this->run($sets, $connection ?? $this->db->getDefaultConnection());
    }

    public function migrateSets(array $ids, ?string $connection = null): array
    {
        $sets = array_map($this->sets->get(...), $ids);

        return $this->run($sets, $connection ?? $this->db->getDefaultConnection());
    }

    public function status(SchemaScope $scope, ?string $connection = null): array
    {
        $result = [];
        foreach ($this->sets->forScope($scope, includeModules: true) as $set) {
            $name = $set->connection ?? $connection ?? $this->db->getDefaultConnection();
            $result[] = $this->migrator->usingConnection($name, function () use ($set): SchemaSetStatus {
                $repository = $this->migrator->getRepository();
                $ran = $repository->repositoryExists() ? $repository->getRan() : [];
                $files = array_keys($this->migrator->getMigrationFiles([$set->path]));

                return new SchemaSetStatus($set, array_values(array_intersect($files, $ran)), array_values(array_diff($files, $ran)));
            });
        }

        return $result;
    }

    /**
     * @param  list<SchemaSet>  $sets
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function run(array $sets, string $connection): array
    {
        $driver = $this->db->connection($connection)->getDriverName();
        foreach ($sets as $set) {
            if (! in_array($driver, $set->drivers, true)) {
                throw SchemaSetException::unsupportedDriver($set->id(), $driver);
            }
        }
        if ($sets === []) {
            return [];
        }

        return $this->migrator->usingConnection($connection, function () use ($sets): array {
            $repository = $this->migrator->getRepository();
            if (! $repository->repositoryExists()) {
                $repository->createRepository();
            }
            $before = $repository->getRan();
            $this->migrator->run(array_map(static fn (SchemaSet $s): string => $s->path, $sets));

            return array_values(array_diff($repository->getRan(), $before));
        });
    }
}
```
`Migrator` разрешается из контейнера как `app('migrator')`; привязка в `DatabaseRegistrar`:
`$app->singleton(SchemaSets::class, fn ($app) => new TaggedSchemaSets($app->tagged(SchemaSetProvider::class)));`
`$app->singleton(SchemaMigrator::class, fn ($app) => new LaravelSchemaMigrator($app->make(SchemaSets::class), $app->make('migrator'), $app->make('db')));`
Commands регистрируются в `boot()` при `runningInConsole()`.

## 4. Команды и трейт тестов

```php
// packages/core/src/Database/Internal/Commands/SchemaMigrateCommand.php
/** @internal */
#[AsCommand(name: 'corex:schema:migrate')]
final class SchemaMigrateCommand extends Command
{
    use ConfirmableTrait;

    protected $signature = 'corex:schema:migrate {--scope=tenant : central|tenant|dedicated} {--database=} {--modules} {--force}';

    protected $description = 'Run the registered CoreX schema sets of one scope.';

    public function handle(SchemaMigrator $migrator): int
    {
        if (! $this->confirmToProceed()) {
            return self::FAILURE;
        }
        $scope = SchemaScope::tryFrom((string) $this->option('scope'));
        if ($scope === null) {
            $this->error('Unknown scope.');

            return self::INVALID;
        }
        $database = $this->option('database');
        $ran = $migrator->migrate($scope, is_string($database) ? $database : null, (bool) $this->option('modules'));
        $this->line($ran === [] ? 'Nothing to migrate.' : implode(PHP_EOL, $ran));

        return self::SUCCESS;
    }
}
```
`SchemaStatusCommand` (`corex:schema:status {--scope=tenant} {--database=}`) — таблица `set | scope | lifecycle | version | applied | pending`,
exit 1 при любом pending у Platform-набора.

```php
// packages/core/src/Database/Testing/MigratesSchemaSets.php
/**
 * Testbench helper: builds package tables through the same registry production uses,
 * so tests never name migration paths.
 */
#[Spi(kind: SpiKind::Call, since: '1.0')]
trait MigratesSchemaSets
{
    /** @param list<string> $ids */
    protected function migrateSchemaSets(array $ids, ?string $connection = null): void
    {
        $this->app->make(SchemaMigrator::class)->migrateSets($ids, $connection);
    }

    protected function migrateSchemaScope(SchemaScope $scope = SchemaScope::Tenant, ?string $connection = null, bool $includeModules = true): void
    {
        $this->app->make(SchemaMigrator::class)->migrate($scope, $connection, $includeModules);
    }
}
```

## 6. Имя объекта ≤ 63

```php
// Только для автора миграции (печатает литерал), в файл миграции не входит.
function corex_object_name(string $table, string $purpose, string $kind): string
{
    $natural = "{$table}_{$purpose}_{$kind}";
    if (strlen($natural) <= 63) {
        return $natural;
    }

    return substr($natural, 0, 51).'_'.substr(sha1($natural), 0, 8).'_'.$kind;
}
// corex_object_name('sys_attribute_schema_operations', 'entity_attribute_revision', 'uq')
//   → 'sys_attribute_schema_operations_entity_attribute_r_<8hex>_uq' (63 байта)
```

## 8. Тесты механики

`tests/Feature/SchemaSetsTest.php` (root suite; фикстурные провайдеры в `tests/Fixtures/Schema/`), кейсы:
1. Два провайдера, три набора → `all()` отсортирован по id; `forScope(Tenant, false)` исключает Module-набор.
2. Дубликат id → `SchemaSetException` (код `duplicate_set`); одинаковый basename в двух Tenant-наборах → `duplicate_migration`.
3. `requires` неустановленного пакета → набор неактивен; после регистрации провайдера пакета → активен.
4. SQLite-соединение и набор `drivers: ['pgsql']` → `unsupported_driver`, журнал не создан, таблиц нет.
5. `corex:schema:migrate --scope=tenant` на SQLite с фикстурным sqlite-набором → таблицы есть; повтор → «Nothing to migrate.»;
   `corex:schema:status` → exit 0; удалить строку журнала → status exit 1 (pending).
6. `Dedicated` + `--database` → ошибка; `Dedicated` исполняется на `connection` набора (второе SQLite-соединение).
7. `ModuleLifecycle::enable()` фикстурного модуля запускает его Module-набор из реестра (не из installed.json).
8. Негатив: `git grep -n -E "publishes\(.*migrations|publishesMigrations|loadMigrationsFrom" -- packages/*/src products/*/src` пусто
   (в Validation item).

```php
#!/usr/bin/env php
<?php
// scripts/schema-gate.php — S1..S9, see research-P08-design §5. Exit 0 OK, 1 violations, 2 config error.
const FORBIDDEN_UNNAMED = [
    '/->(index|unique|primary|fullText|spatialIndex)\(\s*(\[[^\]]*\]|\'[^\']*\')\s*\)/',
    '/\)->(unique|index|primary)\(\s*\)/',
    '/->foreign\(\s*(\[[^\]]*\]|\'[^\']*\')\s*\)/',
    '/->constrained\(/',
    '/->(nullable)?(Uuid|Ulid|Numeric)?[mM]orphs\(/',
];
const FORBIDDEN_ENUM = ['/->(enum|set)\(/', '/\bAS\s+ENUM\b/i'];
const FORBIDDEN_IMPURE = ['/\b(config|env|app|resolve)\(/', '/DB::connection\(/', '/Schema::connection\(/',
    '/->(insert|update|upsert|delete)\(/', '/new\s+\\\\?[A-Z][A-Za-z\\\\]+\)->getTable\(/'];
const INT32 = '/->(integer|unsignedInteger|smallInteger|unsignedSmallInteger|tinyInteger|unsignedTinyInteger|mediumInteger|unsignedMediumInteger|increments|smallIncrements|tinyIncrements|mediumIncrements)\(\s*\'([a-z0-9_]+)\'/';
const OBJECT_NAME = '/^[a-z0-9_]{1,63}_(pk|uq|ix|fk|ck)$/';
const FILE_NAME = '/^2026_10_01_(\d{2})\d{4}_(create|add)_[a-z0-9_]+\.php$/';
// Literal object names: second argument of index/unique/primary/foreign, `->name('…')` on fluent FKs,
// and `CONSTRAINT <name>` / `INDEX <name>` in raw SQL strings.
```
Таблица кодов пакетов PP — в `scripts/schema-sets.json` (`{"axiomasoft/corex": "01", …}`), генерируется из §4.1; гейт сверяет PP
файла с кодом пакета-владельца набора. Вывод нарушений: `S<n> <file>:<line> <message>`, отсортировано.

## 10. Снимки до/после и diff

Снимок схемы набора создаёт Pest-обёртка `tests/Golden/Support/SnapshotSchemaTest.php` (P08.3; group `pg`; пропускается без env
`SNAPSHOT_SETS`): `SNAPSHOT_SETS=<id,id> SNAPSHOT_OUT=<path> PGSQL_PORT=5434 scripts/php84 vendor/bin/pest tests/Golden/Support/SnapshotSchemaTest.php`
→ fresh schema → `migrateSets(ids)` → `SchemaCatalogue::of(connection)` → JSON формы, описанной в docstring `schema-diff.py`.

`python3 plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P08-design/scripts/schema-diff.py before.json after.json` (готов) печатает по таблице: `+col/-col/~type/~null/~default`, индексы и ограничения сопоставляются по
(таблица, колонки, вид, предикат) — переименование печатается как `rename <old> → <new>`, а не как пара add/drop. Ожидаемые классы:
`rename` (§4.2), `~type int→bigint` (§4.3), `morph` (§4.3), `D114`. Всё прочее — F2.

## 11. D114 — root_accounts и claim/cleanup

```php
// фрагмент 2026_10_01_020040_create_root_accounts.php (порядок колонок как сейчас, `data` удалён)
$table->text('signup_key')->nullable();
$table->text('signup_request_digest')->nullable();
$table->uuid('signup_cluster_id')->nullable();
$table->uuid('signup_template_id')->nullable();
$table->boolean('pool_cleanup')->default(false);
// …
DB::statement("ALTER TABLE root_accounts ADD CONSTRAINT root_accounts_signup_ck CHECK ("
    ."(signup_key IS NULL AND signup_request_digest IS NULL AND signup_cluster_id IS NULL AND signup_template_id IS NULL) OR "
    ."(signup_key IS NOT NULL AND signup_request_digest IS NOT NULL AND signup_cluster_id IS NOT NULL AND signup_template_id IS NOT NULL))");
DB::statement('CREATE UNIQUE INDEX root_accounts_signup_key_uq ON root_accounts (signup_key) WHERE signup_key IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL');
```
`ClaimAccountSignup`:
```php
$bindings = $connection->table('root_accounts')
    ->select(['id', 'status', 'deleted_at', 'signup_key', 'signup_request_digest', 'signup_cluster_id', 'signup_template_id'])
    ->where('signup_key', $request->requestKey)
    ->orderBy('id')->lock('FOR UPDATE')->get();
// candidate: ->whereNull('signup_key') вместо четырёх whereJsonDoesntContainKey (CHECK гарантирует «все или ничего»)
$updated = $connection->update(
    query: "UPDATE root_accounts
        SET status = ?, signup_key = ?, signup_request_digest = ?, signup_cluster_id = ?, signup_template_id = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE id = ? AND status = 'pending' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND signup_key IS NULL",
    bindings: ['provisioning', $request->requestKey, $request->requestDigest, $request->clusterId, $request->templateId, $candidate->id],

// replayResult(): сравнение полей строки с запросом (без json_decode); несовпадение любого поля → ClaimConflict.
```

`PendingPool::clearPending()`: `where('data->pool_cleanup', true)` → `where('pool_cleanup', true)`; маркер:
`->update(['status' => 'provisioning', 'pool_cleanup' => true])`. Порядок «claim-маркер → DROP DATABASE → транзакция DELETE + decrement»
не меняется. Модель `Account`: без `data` в casts/fillable; новые поля не fillable (пишет только SQL claim/cleanup).
